opportunities.name: Bloodmail edge sustain
opportunities.objective: Test bloodmail edge sustain against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: The Darkin Blade's 0.6-0.9 AD ratio and 75% edge bonus let Bloodmail's health-to-AD feed spell damage; World Ender amplifies AD and self-healing, while Sundered Sky rewards the attack between casts.
opportunities.requiredState: Land Q edges and one attack before disengaging.
opportunities.failure: W escape and healing reduction break the loop.
opportunities.test: Compare three edge hits and healing over ten seconds at equal gold.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Health never grants unlimited healing; E Stat(12)[statFormula=2] needs mapping.

opportunities.name: Passive double-strike window
opportunities.objective: Test passive double-strike window against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Deathbringer Stance deals max-health physical damage and attacks reduce its cooldown by two seconds; Trinity supplies Spellblade on the attack after E, while Blade of the Ruined King adds independent attack damage. Q edges still refund more passive cooldown than normal attacks.
opportunities.requiredState: Fight inside attack range and weave Q edges.
opportunities.failure: Attack purchases weaken the normal Q burst and expose him to kiting.
opportunities.test: Count passive activations across twelve seconds versus the spell build.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Spellblade and Blade damage are separate packets, not doubled by Q edges.

ruledOut.reason: Health never grants unlimited healing; E Stat(12)[statFormula=2] needs mapping.

unknowns: Item and ability proc attribution requires a controlled current-patch test; symbolic statFormula and source flags are not runtime verification.

builds.summary: Test bloodmail edge sustain against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.goal: Test bloodmail edge sustain against the conventional damage pattern at equal gold.
builds.hypothesis: The Darkin Blade's 0.6-0.9 AD ratio and 75% edge bonus let Bloodmail's health-to-AD feed spell damage; World Ender amplifies AD and self-healing, while Sundered Sky rewards the attack between casts.
testPlan: Required state: Land Q edges and one attack before disengaging.
Compare three edge hits and healing over ten seconds at equal gold.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: W escape and healing reduction break the loop.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Health never grants unlimited healing; E Stat(12)[statFormula=2] needs mapping.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Overlord's Bloodmail, Sundered Sky, Black Cleaver, Spirit Visage, Sterak's Gage, Plated Steelcaps. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Aatrox reveals his true demonic form, Fearing nearby minions for [3] seconds and gaining [(0.6 / 0.8 / 1) × 100]% Move Speed decaying over [10] seconds. He also gains [(0.2 / 0.3 / 0.4) × 100]% Attack Damage and increases self-healing by [(0.5 / 0.75 / 1) × 100]% for the duration.

Champion takedowns extend the duration of this effect by [5] seconds and refresh the Move Speed effect.

Aatrox slams his greatsword, dealing [10 / 25 / 40 / 55 / 70 + (0.6 / 0.675 / 0.75 / 0.825 / 0.9) × AD] physical damage. If they are hit on the edge, they are briefly Knocked Up and they take [(10 / 25 / 40 / 55 / 70 + (0.6 / 0.675 / 0.75 / 0.825 / 0.9) × AD) × ((1 + 0.75))] instead. This Ability can be Recast twice, each one changing shape and dealing 25% more damage than the previous one.

Passive: Aatrox heals for [(16 + (0.013) × Stat(12)[statFormula=2]) × (0.01)] of the damage he deals to Champions.

Active: Aatrox dashes. He can use this Ability while winding up his other Abilities.
